welcome_quote_1: Premium digital products at the best prices — fast, secure and fully automated delivery.
welcome_quote_2: Tap Shop below to buy in the bot, or open the Mini App.
verif_quote_1: We run the official eligibility check on your own account — you keep the account, we do the verification.
verif_step_1: 1. Open the mini app and pick what you want verified.
verif_step_2: 2. Pay there and hand over what the check needs.
verif_step_3: 3. We run it and tell you the result.
verif_quote_2: This one is bought in the mini app: the check is tied to your session there, so it cannot be started from the bot.
escrow_quote_1: Safe deals under escrow protection. Create a deal or withdraw your balance — all right here.
escrow_step_1: 1. Create a deal and send the link to the other side.
escrow_step_2: 2. The buyer funds it — the money is frozen, not sent to the seller.
escrow_step_3: 3. The seller delivers in the deal chat.
escrow_step_4: 4. The buyer confirms and the money is released. If something is wrong, open a dispute and the funds stay frozen until the team decides.
escrow_step_5: 5. Never deal outside escrow, never release before you receive the item.
escrow_quote_2: ⚠️ The escrow balance is a separate wallet. It is not your shop balance: money deposited here cannot pay for shop products, and your shop balance cannot fund a deal. Each is topped up and withdrawn on its own.
ref_quote_1: Share your link and earn free tokens.
ref_step_1: 1. Send your link to a friend.
ref_step_2: 2. They start the bot and subscribe to the channel.
ref_quote_2: Up to 100 referrals count towards tokens.
methods_quote_1: A private group with every working method, kept up to date. Buy once for the period you pick.
methods_quote_2: Bought in the mini app — the bot then sends you a one-time invite link to the group.
notif_quote: Tap to switch each one on or off.
